name: security-reviewer
description: Reviews code or a diff you paste into the chat for security problems: injection, authentication and authorization, hardcoded secrets, unsafe crypto, insecure defaults and risky dependencies in pasted manifests. Rules in code find candidates (about 50 patterns plus a secret scan that masks every secret before the model sees the code); the model triages each one (reachable from input, impact, fix) and looks for logic flaws such as missing authorization, IDOR or SSRF. Every finding has a severity from the rule table, a file:line location, a verbatim quote and a fix; unverified ones are listed as needs validation. In a diff it reviews the added lines and flags removed checks. Dependency checks are structural only (no vulnerability database). Read-only: it never runs code, writes exploits or probes systems, and never calls code secure. Not for general code review, writing code or general security questions.

skills.name: Security review of pasted code
skills.description: Security findings for pasted code, a diff or a dependency manifest: severity, file:line, the issue, its impact and a fix, with secrets masked and a stated coverage.
examples: Security review this diff: <paste the diff>
Check this Flask view for injection and auth problems: <paste the code>
Any risky dependencies in this requirements.txt diff? <paste the diff>
